title: Fraction charts identify the two quotient kernels
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $h:T\to S$, $\mathcal E$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and $D$ a normalized tautological quotient on $P=\operatorname{Proj}_S\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)$ [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data]. Let $L$ be invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], $q:h^*\mathcal E\to L$ an epimorphism, and $\psi$ a graded extension with a morphism $F:T\to P$ satisfying all homogeneous fraction charts [lem-trf-line-quotient-homogeneous-fraction-map]. Let $q_F:h^*\mathcal E\to F^*D.\mathrm{line}$ denote the normalized pulled quotient [def-trf-line-quotient-chart-inverse-data]. For every module $N$ on $T$ and every morphism $r:N\to h^*\mathcal E$, one has $r;q_F=0$ if and only if $r;q=0$.

source.place: Tags 01OA (section-projective-bundle) and 01O4 (lemma-apply-relative); inverse quotient constructions and their arbitrary-pullback compatibility, with the explicit degree-one chart calculations.

proof.text: Apply the sectionwise fraction-kernel comparison on every open to the section r(x). Module-sheaf hom extensionality then turns the pointwise equivalence into the biconditional that the two composites are zero.

lean.statement: theorem lineQuotient_fraction_kernel {S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ S) (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] (D : TautologicalQuotient E) (L : T.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (q : (tensorPullback h).obj E ⟶ L) [Epi q] (ψ : RelativeGradedLineMap h (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E) L) (F : T ⟶ (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj) (hψ : ψ.ExtendsLineQuotient h E L q) (hcharts : ψ.HasQuotientFractionCharts h E L q F) : ∀ (N : T.Modules) (r : N ⟶ (tensorPullback h).obj E), r ≫ pulledQuotient D h F hcharts.1 = 0 ↔ r ≫ q = 0
